# Hershy

> An AI toolkit for short-form video creators. Hershy finds ideas already working
> on competitor channels, checks a hook and script before filming, and after a
> Short is posted it watches the video and reads the creator's real YouTube
> retention curve to say exactly which seconds lost viewers and what edit fixes
> them. Shorts only.

Hershy is aimed at people making vertical short-form video (YouTube Shorts,
TikTok, Reels). It is not a general video editor and it does not generate video.
What separates it from a chat wrapper is that a connected YouTube channel gives
it the creator's own audience-retention data, so its feedback is tied to real
drop-off timestamps rather than to opinion.

Its video review is deliberately editor-facing: every fix has to be applicable to
footage the creator already has, inside three minutes in CapCut or Premiere.
It will say "add a cash register sound on the word money at 0:04" or "put a slow
punch-in across the opening clip". It will not tell you to re-shoot or rewrite
the script.

## Tools

- Video Review: watches a Short (pasted YouTube link or an uploaded file), builds
  a beat-by-beat timeline of every cut, overlay and sound, scores it out of 100
  across hook, retention, payoff and delivery, and returns timestamped edit fixes.
  For a creator's own published video it also maps the real retention drop-offs
  onto that timeline.
- Competitors: tracks rival channels and surfaces only the Shorts that clearly
  beat that channel's own median views per day, then rewrites the idea for the
  user's niche instead of copying it.
- Hook Lab: scores a written hook and returns three finished, copy-paste rewrites
  in fixed angles (negative/risk, curiosity gap, contrarian).
- Script Lab: breaks down a full script before filming, with the literal lines to
  paste for trimming, open loops and the closing call to action.

## Pricing

- Free: 20 credits, no card required, one time with no monthly refill. Enough for
  a couple of video reviews or several hook and script checks. Competitors
  requires a paid plan.
- Plus: $9.99 per month, or $119.99 per year. 300 credits per month.
- Pro: $19.99 per month, or $155.99 per year (an effective $12.99 per month).
  1000 credits per month.
- Extra credits: $4.99 for 100.

One credit balance covers every tool, so users only spend on what they use.
